user.title: Connect to Zalo Bot server
user.description: Enter the Zalo Bot server address and the admin account. The password generated by the add-on is in THONG-TIN-DANG-NHAP.txt inside the add-on data directory.

data.enable_notifications: Show result notifications in Home Assistant

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Zalo server. Check the address and port, and that the add-on is running.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the username or password. After several wrong attempts the server locks the IP for 15 minutes.
